detail.longDescription:
Simple. Powerful. Easy to Use. 
jCalc is a scientific calculator designed for students, teachers, and professionals. Whether you're solving fractions, decimals, or advanced equations, jCalc makes it easy and intuitive.

Key Features:
 Fractions and Decimals Made Easy:
 • [1] [.] [2] = 1.2
 • [1] [n/d] [2] = 1/2
 • [1] [n/d] [2] [Nn/d] [3] = 1_2/3

Flexible Answer Formats:
 • Display up to 16 decimal places
 • Results in irrational, rational, decimal, or scientific format
 • Trigonometric results in radians, degrees, or gradians

Smart Conversions:
 • [Ab/c] ⟺ [a/b] ⟺ [a.b] ⟺ [a.b×10^c]

Button Functions You’ll Love:
 • [del]: Delete the last entry
 • [C]: Clear the current expression
 • [AC]: Hold [C] to clear all entries
 • [sci]: Switch to scientific mode
 • [2nd]: Access advanced functions

Advanced Math Features:
 • Memory Functions: Recall previous answers with [ans]
 • Auto Parentheses: No manual typing needed
 • Percent Button: Simplify percentage calculations
 • Scientific Notation: Effortless input for large numbers
 • π Button: Quick access to π

Comprehensive Math Tools:
 • Roots, powers, and exponents
 • Logarithms (including custom bases)
 • Trigonometric and hyperbolic functions ([hyp])
 • Permutations, combinations, and factorials ([prob])

Discover a calculator that’s as simple as it is powerful. Happy calculating!
